runs.question: latest project updates
runs.sql:
SELECT a.action, u.name AS user_name, a.entity_type, a.subject, a.created_at, p.name AS project_name
FROM dbo.activities a
LEFT JOIN dbo.users u ON a.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN dbo.projects p ON a.entity_id = p.id
WHERE a.entity_type = 'Project'
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
